meal.title: Define web scraping
meal.objective: Explain what web scraping is and why it is useful

voice.script: Ever wondered how bots gather headlines from dozens of sites in seconds? What is web scraping and why would you use it? Scraping means parsing a website’s content and pulling out exactly the information you want. It’s useful for collecting data at scale, feeding analysis, or monitoring changes without manual copy‑paste. Now let's see a tiny example. Web scraping lets you automatically collect the data you need from the web. Try listing three websites you could scrape and what data you'd extract.
